prompt: In this new conversation, run the weekly review for the fictional A+ client agreements. List commitments with no recorded owner, give exact source sections, and keep unknown dates unknown. Do not assign anyone.
final_answer:
Here's the weekly review. This is a fictional demonstration scenario — the A+ Active Services agreements are demo documents, and their signing state is a scenario assumption, not a real executed contract. Review date is September 25, 2026. All six clauses below were read from local copies of the source Drive documents (local_copy_of_drive_document), not live Google Drive reads, so the cited text is the local fixture copy.

Unassigned commitments (no recorded owner), in due-date order:

1. APL-001 — Aster Clinical AI. Deliver clinician-manager facilitation plan. Due 2026-09-28. Status open. Source: aster-order-form.md, Section 2.1. 2. APL-003 — Harbor Care Intelligence. Name facilitation escalation contact. Due 2026-09-29. Status open. Source: harbor-msa.md, Section 3.1. A primary and backup contact for workshop delivery concerns; acknowledgment within one business day on Mon–Fri 9 a.m.–5 p.m. America/New_York, excluding US federal holidays. Acknowledgment does not promise resolution.

3. APL-002 — Aster Clinical AI. Approve anonymized listening-session summary. Due 2026-09-30. Status open. Source: aster-msa.md, Section 4.2. Summary must exclude employee attribution, patient information, and raw transcripts; Aster's designated reviewer must approve before wider circulation.

4. APL-008 — Northstar Clinic Network. Confirm site leads and backup contacts. Due 2026-10-01. Status open. Source: northstar-order-form.md, Section 2.1. Site schedule, accessibility plan, and named escalation leads; Northstar confirms room and staff separately.

5. APL-009 — Northstar Clinic Network. Deliver quarterly program review. Due 2026-10-09. Status open. Source: northstar-msa.md, Section 5.2. Review distinguishes completed sessions, open concerns, and next actions; no clinical efficacy claims.

6. APL-004 — Harbor Care Intelligence. Confirm workshop acceptance. Due date unknown — it is unknown, not inferable. Status waiting_on_client. Source: harbor-order-form.md, Section 5.1. Harbor reviews within five business days after delivery, but delivery is unconfirmed, so the acceptance deadline cannot be set as of this review.

No owner has been assigned to any item, as requested. Clinical, privacy, and contract-interpretation questions should be routed to a human.
